question: Within a 150 kilometers range, where can I find a restaurant on the way to Bowditch Middle School Auditorium, Foster City, CA from Sense Fine Art, Menlo Park, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.185358 37.450435)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.248613 37.559053)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.185358 37.450435)',4326)::geography, 150000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.185358 37.450435)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
